name: West Coast Cubing Western FMC Championship 2026
information:
#### WCC's annual FMC championship is here! This year, most locations will also hold a PBQ on the same day! Carefully read the [Westerns PBQ FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCWesternFMCChampionship2026#67479-western-pbq-championship-faq) for more information.

If you would like to participate at one of these locations, please [contact us by using the link here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=WCCWesternFMCChampionship2026&contactRecipient=competition)

---

- This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. **We do not recommend new competitors attend this competition.**

- This competition will take place at different venues across California and Nevada. Please reach out to local delegates to reach out to us about hosting a location.

-  Check out the [Locations Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCWesternFMCChampionship2026#67296-locations) for more details.

This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/).
